content: Řmewt n Yaɛqub d ufekki n Buṭrus
Di řweqt nni ɛřaḥař isswiẓẓeḍ Hirudus afus nnes ḥima ad ikarfes x ca n yinni iǧan zi tmesmunt.
Inɣa Yaɛqub umas n Yuḥanna s ssif.
Umi iẓra aqa man aya iɛjeb asen i Wudayen, ikemmeř deg webrid nni maḥend ad iṭṭef uřa d Cimɛun Buṭrus. Tuɣa d ussan n Weɣrum břa Antun.
Řami t iṭṭef, igga i-t di řeḥbes, uca igga as deg ifassen n setta-ɛecra n iɛessasen, ḥima ad xas ɛessen. Tuɣa ixs ad t iqeddem zzat i Wudayen awarni i Řɛid n Tɣarṣt n Useɛdu.
Umi tuɣa ɛessen x Cimɛun di řeḥbes, tuɣa teẓẓaǧa tmesmunt i AREBBI břa qeṭṭu di ṭṭweɛ nnes.
Di ǧiřet, ɣar tuffut i di tuɣa izɛem Hirudus ad t iqeddem, umi iṭṭeṣ Cimɛun am t cedden s tnayen n ssnaseř jar tnayen n iɛessasen n řɛeskar u inneɣni ḥeṭṭan ɣar tewwart n řeḥbes,
ibedd-dd lmalak n SIDI sennej nnes u ṭṭya n tfawt tᵉttceɛciɛ di marra axxam uca netta iɛarn i-t deg uɣezdis nnes, issfaq i-t, inna: “Kkar deɣya!” Deɣya wḍant ssnaseř zeg ifassen nnes.
Inna as lmalak: “Byes, teqqned tisiřa nnec!” Igga ammu. Inna as xenni: “Arḍ ajeǧab nnec, ḍfar ayi-dd!”
Xenni iffeɣ, iḍfar i-t, war issin min d as igga lmalak, aqa man aya d tidett, maɣar ittɣiř as iẓra ijj n řewḥiy.

Ařami kkin x uɛessas amezwaru d x wenni wiss tnayen, iwḍen ɣar tewwart n wuzzař tenni ittawyen ɣar tendint, tennurzem asen weḥḥdes. Awarni řami zzayes ffɣen, qeḍɛen ict n zzenqet, řexdenni ijja i-t lmalak.
Xenni idweř-dd Cimɛun ɣar řbař nnes, inna: “Řexxu ssneɣ s tidett belli SIDI issekk-dd lmalak nnes, issenjem ayi zeg ifassen n Hirudus u zi marra min zeɛmen ad ayi ggen Wudayen.”
Umi tuɣa ittxarreṣ di man aya, yusa-dd ɣar taddart n Maryam, yemmas n Yuḥanna, wenni ittkennan Markus, mani tuɣa ttmunan aṭṭas, ttẓaǧan din.
Ařami issqarqeb di tewwart n barra n řemraḥ, tusa-dd ict n tḥenjirt, qqaren as Ruda ḥima ad tseř wi dinni.
Teɛqeř tmijja n Cimɛun, uca zi ssibbet n řefraḥet war tarzim ca tewwart, maca teɛqeb deɣya uca txebbar i-ten, inna asen: “Xzar, Cimɛun, aqa ibedd ɣar tewwart n řemraḥ!”
Nnan as: “Aqa cem txeřfed!” Maca nettat teqqim teqqar aqa man aya nican. Nnan as: “Ma ad taɣ d lmalak nnes!”
Maca Cimɛun, iqqim issqarqub uca ffɣen, ẓrin t uca tbehten.
Iceyyar asen s ufus nnes ḥima ad sqaren uca iɛawed asen mammec t-i-dd-issuffeɣ SIDI zi řeḥbes, inna: “Xebbarem Yaɛqub d tawmat x uya!” Xenni iffeɣ ɣar ijj n wemcan nneɣni.
Řami dd-yiweḍ uziř, imsar ijj n uxarweḍ i war iǧin drust jar řɛeskar x min imsaren i Cimɛun.
Awarni řami tuɣa xas yarezzu Hirudus, maca war t yufi, iḥkem x iɛessasen s řmewt, iffeɣ zi Yahudiyya, iqqim izeddeɣ di Qayṣariya.
Řmewt n Hirudus Aɣripas

Umi tuɣa řeɛdawet di Hirudus ḍidd i ayt n Ṣur d Ṣaydun, munen nitni, iwḍen ad ssqenɛen Blastus amsexxar icennɛen n ujeǧid uca ttaren as maḥend ad asen iwc ijj n weṣřaḥ, minzi macca n temmurt nsen tekka-dd zi tgeldit n Hirudus.
Deg ijj n wass n řfarḥ ittwassnen yarḍ Hirudus ajeǧab n ujeǧid am iqqim x řkursi n ccreɛ, uca issiweř i řɣaci.
Uca marra řgens isɣuy ɣares: “Aqa d awařen n AREBBI, war iǧi n bnadem.”
Řexdenni iwta i-t lmalak n SIDI, minzi netta war iwci aɛuǧi i AREBBI. Uca dřen t ikeccawen, iffeɣ zzayes buḥbeř.
Awař n AREBBI ittwabarreḥ zzayes, imeqqar.
Bar-Naba d Cawul ɛeqben-dd zi Urcalim ɣar Antiyukiya awarni řami kemmřen tasexxart nsen uca iwyen akidsen Yuḥanna, wenni umi ttkennan Markus.
